chrome.deterministicPolicy: same seeded random and one-frame harness policy

webgpu_compute_rasterizer.rootCause: The example resolves related triangle and instance payloads through separate atomicMax operations, so one contested pixel may legally receive a torn pair. All deterministic geometry and the remaining framebuffer match on the same adapter.

webgpu_lights_custom.rootCause: Bundled golden adapter/backend numeric output; same-adapter Chrome and native output match exactly after applying the same UUID-independent seeded-random policy.

webgpu_lights_pointlights.rootCause: Bundled golden adapter/backend numeric output; same-adapter Chrome and native output match exactly.

webgpu_lights_rectarealight.rootCause: Same-adapter rendering reduces the difference below the strict threshold; residual pixels are edge quantization between Dawn and wgpu-core.

webgpu_lines_fat_raycasting.rootCause: Same-adapter geometry and line coverage match except for one thresholded pixel.

webgpu_materials_arrays.rootCause: Same-adapter Chrome and native output match exactly.

webgpu_materials_envmaps_bpcem.rootCause: The bundled adapter accounts for nearly all reflected-radiance differences; same-adapter output is structurally identical with a 0.009 percentage-point threshold excess at reflection edges.

webgpu_refraction.rootCause: Same-adapter refraction, depth, and sampling output match below threshold.

webgpu_textures_anisotropy.rootCause: The bundled golden was generated with materially different anisotropic filtering. With the same 800x500 CSS viewport, seeded policy, NVIDIA adapter, and Vulkan backend, Dawn and wgpu-core output match exactly.

webgpu_volume_lighting_rectarea.rootCause: Same-adapter Chrome and native output match exactly.

webgpu_materials_texture_manualmipmap.rootCause: All manually supplied mip levels and quadrant boundaries are present and stable. Chrome's first deterministic frame does not redraw every asynchronously compiled object, so a same-frame browser differential is not a valid resource-state comparison.

webgpu_multisampled_renderbuffers.rootCause: With an identical 800x500 CSS viewport, color/depth resolves and wireframe coverage match same-adapter Chrome exactly.
